entities.summary: The Berlin Botanic Garden and Botanical Museum is a botanical garden in the Lichterfelde locality of the borough of Steglitz-Zehlendorf, Berlin, Germany. Constructed between 1897 and 1910 under the guidance of architect Adolf Engler, it has an area of 42 hectares [ha] and over 20,000 different plant species. The garden is part of the Free University of Berlin and attracts about half a million visitors annually.
